body: I slowly and cautiously move towards the radio, my eyes scanning the surrounding area for any signs of danger. As I draw closer, I notice the voice seems to be coming from an old, dusty radio, partially buried in the dirt. The words are faint, but I make out a few phrases: "The show must go on" and "Prepare for transmission." My curiosity is piqued, and I wonder what story this old radio might tell.
